# Heartify

> Heartify is a clean, Islamic-friendly video and audio app with curated, distraction-free halal content for focused and mindful viewing.

Heartify curates videos and audio from trusted creators across categories like Quran, lectures, nasheeds, learning, and family-friendly content. The moderation pipeline filters non-halal material before it reaches viewers.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Curated halal videos, audio, and daily doses.
- [Search](/search): Search the curated halal library.
- [Channels](/channels): Browse trusted creators and channels.
- [Privacy](/privacy): How Heartify handles your data.
- [Terms](/terms): Terms of service.

## Optional

- [Sign in](/login): Existing account sign-in.
- [Sign up](/signup): Create a Heartify account.
